risk_note: F1-08as (replaces F1-08ar; D10-2060 / 2061 / 2062; owner approved the frozen change D10-2083 / approvals #108). After a write entered result-unknown, a retry answered with 10403 admin_permission_denied or 10003 verify_phone_missing (both checked before the idempotent replay and dependent on state) keeps the unknown state: same key and body, inputs locked, only retry / check-the-list. 20001 still unlocks with a new key; a plain 10003 still re-verifies; first-submission refusals unchanged; no automatic resend. Applied in useAdjustmentWrite (create, reverse, approve, reject, write-off) and ManualPaid. Frozen [AC-F1-08al-ERROR#1] changed in the lost-first + 10403 branch only (modify_existing, rule_change). Rule tests and spec-test by independent Claude contexts; money review by an independent Claude (D10-2003). Implementation by Opus 5.5. Written by hand.

reviews.note: Independent Claude via tools/agent/claude-run.sh (approvals #36, D10-2003). Pass, 0 findings; out_of_scope: result-unknown lost on re-login after 10001 (D10-2061 known limitation, FU-ADMIN-UNKNOWN-ON-RELOGIN = F1-08at). couli-runs/F1-08as/review-claude-money-r1.json

spec_test_review.note: tests by independent Claude contexts (claude-run.sh): F1-08ar round 1 reused as the starting point (D10-2062), F1-08as round 1 on top; spec-test r1 by another independent Claude, pass (one S2 handled as an implementation hard constraint and checked by the money review)
